notes.title: KELDER – Major Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I’ve been observing and taking notes from your gameplay and feedback, and working really hard to deliver this [b]major update[/b] in a short time. This patch brings a lot of new content, system improvements, and bug fixes that should make the experience smoother, scarier, and more immersive.[/p][p]                       [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/d7a135e269cef841a1727b0a5952926847b45ba5.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Top Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Journal System[/b] – keeps track of thoughts, tasks, and hints, with a UI notification for new notes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full Tutorial Section[/b] – learn the core mechanics through an integrated tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Entities[/b] – each with unique stories and behaviours.[/p][/*][*][p][b]80+ New Events[/b] – complete overhaul of encounters and event system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Overhaul[/b] – updated global illumination and post-processing for more comfortable visuals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Levels[/b] – new paths, rooms, and more save points across multiple levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard Key binding[/b] – players can now rebind their keys.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Journal system[/b] for player thoughts, tasks, and hints.[/p][/*][*][p]Journal UI updates when a new note is added.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]full tutorial section[/b] with UI integration.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]3 new entities[/b] with unique stories and behaviours.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]~80 new events[/b] with a complete overhaul of the encounter system.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay & Systems[/h3][list][*][p]Save system updated with more save points and locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Save UI now notifies players when progress is saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Save system improved to prevent rare softlock cases on critical paths.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now [b]rebind keyboard keys[/b] from the controls menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical events rebalanced and updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Levels[/h3][list][*][p][b]Level 0[/b] slightly updated; location changes in location of Map 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 1[/b] updated with a new critical path at the end.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 2[/b] expanded with more save points.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 3[/b] extended with a large new room.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Character camera [b]post-processing[/b] updated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Global illumination[/b] completely overhauled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player vision[/b] adjusted for short-distance visibility in low light.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PODV entity[/b] improved with new behaviour, effects, and encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Darkness entity[/b] updated with better interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chairguy[/b] updated with improved door interactions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radio[/b] modified with better responses and fixed rare incorrect lines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player sound system[/b] updated for more accurate sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed subtitle errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Interaction objects are now more responsive.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: KELDER - Update 1.1 is in the works!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to let you know that Update [b]1.1[/b] is currently in development!
This update will include:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/88cae341491732be758d7ce2c12402b403392ea9.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New entities[/b] - some that were originally cut during development are finally making their way into the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extended areas[/b] - environments have been expanded and adjusted to create a smoother, more fluid experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgraded systems[/b] - fresh tweaks and mechanics to keep you on your toes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you’ve already played the game, we’d love it if you could leave us a [b]positive review[/b] - it really helps the game grow and reach more players.[/p][p]And if you have [b]feedback[/b], please share it! I’m actively reading your comments, listening, and working hard to improve the game for everyone.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey - more details on Update 1.1 will be coming soon![/p]

notes.title: KELDER – Development Update & Roadmap
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This past weekend, [b]KELDER[/b] went live and many gamers and streamers had the chance to experience it. I've been carefully watching playthroughs, reading feedback, and taking notes on what worked and what needs improvement.[/p][p]I want to share that [b]KELDER[/b] will continue to receive [b]regular updates[/b] until it fully becomes the ultimate horror experience I envision. Some content had to be cut due to time constraints, but I plan to reintroduce parts of it, expand on what's already there, and refine the overall experience to deliver a more intense and consistent sense of horror. I also aim to add additional language support so more players can experience [b]KELDER.[/b][/p][p]Here's a look at what's coming in future updates:[/p][p]    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051566/3b905b29c2e390e833db639576823981fc9483bc.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Upcoming Changes & Additions[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Entity Improvements[/b] – Smarter, more dynamic behavior for certain entities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Areas[/b] – Some locations will be extended with new details and surprises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Micro-Events[/b] – Additional random encounters in pathways to keep players on edge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Path Enhancements[/b] – More dynamics and clearer navigation hints.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] – More languages will be added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cut Content Returns[/b] – A few previously cut entities will be reintroduced (their documents and hints are already in-game).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster AI Upgrades[/b] – Both main monsters will become more responsive, adaptive, and engaged with the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Events[/b] – Hidden environmental scares to reward exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Readable Notes[/b] – More in-world notes to expand lore and improve immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable Controls[/b] – More rebindable options for comfortable play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Summary[/b] – Final results screen at the end of each run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Global Controller System[/b] – A refined feature that ensures every encounter is random, but now with more adaptive and sophisticated control tailored to each player's journey.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This is just the beginning. I'll be working continuously to shape [i]KELDER[/i] into the horror experience it's meant to be. Thank you all for playing, streaming, and sharing your thoughts. Your feedback is driving the next phase of development, and I can't wait to show you what's next.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and stay in the dark.[/p]

notes.title: It's Almost Time: Final Trailer + Release Date Incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]It is almost time[/h1][p][/p][p]We've been deep in the basement getting everything ready — and now, it's official:[/p][list][*][p]Localization — done[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements — added[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs — squashed[/p][/*][*][p]Nightmares — preserved[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]On [b]26th of July[/b], we're dropping the [b]final trailer for KELDER[/b] — and along with it, the long-awaited [b]release date[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This is it — the last stop before launch.[/p][p]
Grab your flashlight. Tell your friends. The basement is calling.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist KELDER [/b][/p][p]Thanks for the patience and support — we're nearly there.[/p][p]— THOs Dev[/p]
